decision.reason: [ev-12d2733c5dd3] only says the vCert upgrade fixes RSA 3072 bit keys for Venafi TPP enrollment. It names no Certificate or Issuer fields, so the proposed paths (spec.privateKey.algorithm, spec.privateKey.size, spec.issuerRef → spec.venafi.tpp) and their exact states come from the proposal, not the evidence. The condition also requires algorithm to equal "RSA". That would miss exposed Certificates if an unset algorithm also gives an RSA key, and nothing shown settles whether it does. Deciding needs the PR #7498 diff or the Certificate/Issuer API reference: which fields select a TPP issuer and a 3072-bit RSA key, the algorithm default, and whether ClusterIssuers or bare CertificateRequests are also exposed.
